name: cbb-sabermetrics
description: Verified college baseball records, rosters, schedules, standings and statistics with season-specific sources.

interface.shortDescription: Verified college baseball records, rosters, schedules, standings and statistics with season-specific sources.
interface.longDescription: Retrieve college baseball observations through the BSI MCP and inspect official school, conference and association sources. Verify season, identity and coverage before reporting records, rosters, schedules and team or individual statistics. Includes a local HTML source helper for execution-capable hosts; availability of live fields depends on the connected server and sources.
interface.defaultPrompt: Get Texas baseball records, roster and individual stats for the season I ask for, with official sources and coverage dates.
